answer: Bindings are kept in vine, verified in meadow, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the jetty check. Each duplicate costs another 23 dollars in locked collateral and another 9 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
